name: policy_apparel_restocking_fee_policy_tool
use_case: Answer return and exchange policy questions with citations
branch: Customer asks whether restocking fees apply to apparel returns; the agent checks the Apparel policy using get_return_policy and confirms 0% restocking fee.
tests: Verifies the agent looks up the Apparel policy via get_return_policy and explains that no restocking fee applies, citing the policy version.
instruction: Ask Northgate Outfitters customer support whether there are any restocking fees deducted when returning an apparel item like SKU AP01. If the agent asks for the item type, clarify that it is clothing/apparel.

persona.name: Jack Wilson
persona.initial_message: Hi, does Northgate Outfitters charge any restocking fee if I return a jacket or shirt (Apparel)?
